notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.8:
- Much faster GeoTIFF export. Exporting the whole orthomosaic now copies the finished tiles straight into the new file instead of decompressing and compressing every pixel again, so it takes about as long as copying the file. Field exports copy the tiles inside the field the same way and only redo the tiles along the field edge, several at a time.
- No extra quality loss: exported pixels are the orthomosaic's own pixels (before, every export went through a second round of JPEG compression).
- Field exports now line up with the orthomosaic's 512-pixel tiles, so a field's file can extend a few metres past the field outline; that margin is transparent, as before.
